d: Union Home Minister Amit Shah on Saturday, November 21, 2026, assured residents of Arunachal Pradesh's Siang Valley that their concerns over the proposed 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project (SUMP) will be addressed through dialogue. Speaking at the Police Training Centre in Banderdewa near Itanagar during a three-day visit to the state, Shah urged protesters to engage with the state government and promised "one of the country's most attractive" rehabilitation and resettlement packages for affected families.
